# DataDrivenCellularAxis

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-07-30

## Definition
A cellular architecture axis derived from BigBrain 3D histology, ranging from 'peaked' (high hierarchical differentiation) to 'flat' (low hierarchical differentiation) across DMN regions. This axis provides a biologically grounded gradient for designing neuromorphic interconnect topologies that emulate hierarchical processing depth in iNEST systems.
